## Install
- Easiest: install the **ArtCraft Launcher** from the [suite release](https://github.com/Labtoso/Artcraft/releases/tag/suite); it installs and updates every app.
- Or download the file for your system below: `windows-x64.msi` (installer) or `windows-x64.zip` (portable) for Windows, `.AppImage`, `.deb`, `.rpm` or `.tar.gz` for Linux, `macos-universal.dmg` for macOS (Apple silicon and Intel). Checksums are in `SHA256SUMS`.
- macOS: the apps are not notarized by Apple. After the first start, open *System Settings → Privacy & Security* and click *Open Anyway* (or run `xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/<App>.app`).

latest_release.notes_markdown:
## Added
- Craft Anything 0.3.0, built from the original release [v0.3.0](https://github.com/storytold/craft-anything/releases/tag/v0.3.0) without community links (Discord, social networks).

## Fixed
- Everything the original v0.3.0 fixed, see its release notes below.

## Install
- Easiest: install the **ArtCraft Launcher** from the [suite release](https://github.com/Labtoso/Artcraft/releases/tag/suite); it installs and updates every app.
- Or download the file for your system below: `windows-x64.msi` (installer) or `windows-x64.zip` (portable) for Windows, `.AppImage`, `.deb`, `.rpm` or `.tar.gz` for Linux, `macos-universal.dmg` for macOS (Apple silicon and Intel). Checksums are in `SHA256SUMS`.
- macOS: the apps are not notarized by Apple. After the first start, open *System Settings → Privacy & Security* and click *Open Anyway* (or run `xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/<App>.app`).

---

### Original release notes

## What's Changed
* A .utoc naming billions of empty compression methods no longer runs out of memory by @Agapenordev in https://github.com/storytold/craft-anything/pull/61
* Find the Windows shim, not npm's POSIX script, for a bare program name by @muraa-p in https://github.com/storytold/craft-anything/pull/51
* Every engine listing finds a Ghidra installed in a versioned folder or set through its folder setting by @aweussom in https://github.com/storytold/craft-anything/pull/55
* Leave a pin's old program copies out of the copy by @muraa-p in https://github.com/storytold/craft-anything/pull/56
* Look for Claude Code where WinGet installs it by @justinjohn0306 in https://github.com/storytold/craft-anything/pull/65
* Analysing code at the top of the address space finishes instead of running forever by @Agapenordev in https://github.com/storytold/craft-anything/pull/78
* The macOS app ships craft-anything-cli beside its executable by @bflatastic in https://github.com/storytold/craft-anything/pull/99
* Codex runs in project folders that aren't git repositories by @bflatastic in https://github.com/storytold/craft-anything/pull/101
* Find Ghidra installed from a Linux package by @bflatastic in https://github.com/storytold/craft-anything/pull/103
* Emit object schemas for compare inputs by @TheGalitube in https://github.com/storytold/craft-anything/pull/93
* Wait for asset facts to load in the asset spending smoke test by @WadahBadawi in https://github.com/storytold/craft-anything/pull/76
* Scope test structs FlakyKind and FlakyCheck to unix by @WadahBadawi in https://github.com/storytold/craft-anything/pull/52
* Frida lists devices and processes on Windows instead of hanging or finding none by @vdidon in https://github.com/storytold/craft-anything/pull/59
* Add a French UI translation by @VakzOs in https://github.com/storytold/craft-anything/pull/70
* Add a Japanese README by @zitann2020 in https://github.com/storytold/craft-anything/pull/80
* The Make screen says Craft Anything looks at the original, not an unnamed "we" by @bflatastic in https://github.com/storytold/craft-anything/pull/107
* Add a Japanese UI by @zitann2020 in https://github.com/storytold/craft-anything/pull/87
* The Agent console keeps its size instead of growing until its tabs are cut off by @Agapenordev in https://github.com/storytold/craft-anything/pull/81
* Why we ask is shown on the first-run purpose page, not hidden in a hover tip by @bflatastic in https://github.com/storytold/craft-anything/pull/106
* The Settings window keeps its width on every tab by @bflatastic in https://github.com/storytold/craft-anything/pull/108
* A rebuilt stand-in waits for its predecessor's port instead of failing by @bflatastic in https://github.com/storytold/craft-anything/pull/109
* Look for AI offers local servers already set up in OpenCode by @bflatastic in https://github.com/storytold/craft-anything/pull/111
* Fall back to BM_CLICK for off-screen Win32 buttons and check boxes in UI walkthroughs by @WadahBadawi in https://github.com/storytold/craft-anything/pull/77
* Sync the Craft App Suite list by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/craft-anything/pull/119
* Choose an agent app's program in Settings → AI by @bflatastic in https://github.com/storytold/craft-anything/pull/117
* Add Simplified and Traditional Chinese UI translations (R2.9) by @CQMHV in https://github.com/storytold/craft-anything/pull/115
* Godot installs on macOS: its program may be bigger than other engines' files by @bflatastic in https://github.com/storytold/craft-anything/pull/118
* Find coding agents in OpenCode's install folder and under nvm by @bflatastic in https://github.com/storytold/craft-anything/pull/120
* The macOS Dock shows the app's icon at the same size as other apps' by @bflatastic in https://github.com/storytold/craft-anything/pull/121
* Translate the agent program setting into Chinese by @bflatastic in https://github.com/storytold/craft-anything/pull/122
* Draw CJK interface text in a sans font, not a mincho by @zitann2020 in https://github.com/storytold/craft-anything/pull/125
* A program run in a console on Windows doesn't lose what it wrote on a busy computer by @bflatastic in https://github.com/storytold/craft-anything/pull/126
* Name the font fallback order, and test the order itself by @zitann2020 in https://github.com/storytold/craft-anything/pull/129
* A Flutter library with a header table at the very end of the address range is read without overflowing (R0.5) by @Agapenordev in https://github.com/storytold/craft-anything/pull/131
* Look for AI picks a model that can chat, not an embedding model by @bflatastic in https://github.com/storytold/craft-anything/pull/134
* Test that a stopped stand-in frees its port where the server is, without racing other tests by @bflatastic in https://github.com/storytold/craft-anything/pull/136
* Add an AI by its address in Settings → AI by @bflatastic in https://github.com/storytold/craft-anything/pull/137
* Find coding agents npm installed under a custom prefix by @bflatastic in https://github.com/storytold/craft-anything/pull/139
* Choose the model an AI uses in Settings → AI by @bflatastic in https://github.com/storytold/craft-anything/pull/145
* Find the Godot editor that the store installs on macOS by @olebohmbach in https://github.com/storytold/craft-anything/pull/141
* A rate-limited AI service is waited for as long as it asks by @bflatastic in https://github.com/storytold/craft-anything/pull/148
* Pitfall: merge the commit CI tested, not a head read later by @bflatastic in https://github.com/storytold/craft-anything/pull/150
* Give every Settings tab the same width, with air before the scroll bar by @olebohmbach in https://github.com/storytold/craft-anything/pull/151
* A full-page website capture scrolls through the page first by @bflatastic in https://github.com/storytold/craft-anything/pull/168
* An out-of-date Claude Code says so, and how to update it by @bflatastic in https://github.com/storytold/craft-anything/pull/169
* A website capture refuses the browser's error page by @bflatastic in https://github.com/storytold/craft-anything/pull/171
* The README and STATUS give today's tool counts by @bflatastic in https://github.com/storytold/craft-anything/pull/172
* When the window can't open, the app says why instead of vanishing by @bflatastic in https://github.com/storytold/craft-anything/pull/173
* Browser evidence records Clean room when the run is in Clean room by @bflatastic in https://github.com/storytold/craft-anything/pull/177
* A failed build check says where it looked, not app/ for an app edited in place by @bflatastic in https://github.com/storytold/craft-anything/pull/178
* A question answered outside a build stays in the project's conversation by @bflatastic in https://github.com/storytold/craft-anything/pull/180
* Pitfall: never type python - with a heredoc by @bflatastic in https://github.com/storytold/craft-anything/pull/181
* Add Antigravity (agy) agent CLI adapter and setup support by @x-eon-max in https://github.com/storytold/craft-anything/pull/89
* Clean room captures leave out class names and query strings by @bflatastic in https://github.com/storytold/craft-anything/pull/183
* Setup and the doctor read a client's other names from one table by @bflatastic in https://github.com/storytold/craft-anything/pull/184
* Cover the unknown-font rank in the fallback order test by @zitann2020 in https://github.com/storytold/craft-anything/pull/187
* A pill corner made with calc(infinity * 1px) is captured as 9999px by @rech4210 in https://github.com/storytold/craft-anything/pull/189
* Add a Simplified Chinese README by @maple323 in https://github.com/storytold/craft-anything/pull/188
* Detect Unreal Engine installations and Clang on Linux (R1.6) by @one-bit in https://github.com/storytold/craft-anything/pull/191
* The Windows app no longer starts OpenGL, which crashed some Intel drivers before the window opened by @bflatastic in https://github.com/storytold/craft-anything/pull/198
* Codex is never run as plain text, which opened its interactive mode by @bflatastic in https://github.com/storytold/craft-anything/pull/200
* An A32 doubleword load or store into r15 decodes as invalid instead of stopping the ARM analysis by @rech4210 in https://github.com/storytold/craft-anything/pull/204
* A Mach-O method list at the end of the address space is read without overflowing by @rech4210 in https://github.com/storytold/craft-anything/pull/205
* Reject overflowing bits in 10-byte uleb128 values by @Silvertree2010 in https://github.com/storytold/craft-anything/pull/208
* Captured colours are the page's CSS values, not a canvas read that drifted by one by @bflatastic in https://github.com/storytold/craft-anything/pull/211
* The Windows pipe gap in project_play is noted in its tool help and kept as an ignored test by @rech4210 in https://github.com/storytold/craft-anything/pull/212
* From the CLI, a capture with no open site says each command starts its own browser by @bflatastic in https://github.com/storytold/craft-anything/pull/213
* Try the DX12 adapter before Vulkan when the app starts by @muraa-p in https://github.com/storytold/craft-anything/pull/217

latest_release.name: TextureCraft 0.3.2
latest_release.notes_markdown:
## Added
- TextureCraft 0.3.2, built from the original release [v0.3.2](https://github.com/storytold/texturecraft/releases/tag/v0.3.2) without community links (Discord, social networks).

## Fixed
- Everything the original v0.3.2 fixed, see its release notes below.

## Install
- Easiest: install the **ArtCraft Launcher** from the [suite release](https://github.com/Labtoso/Artcraft/releases/tag/suite); it installs and updates every app.
- Or download the file for your system below: `windows-x64.msi` (installer) or `windows-x64.zip` (portable) for Windows, `.AppImage`, `.deb`, `.rpm` or `.tar.gz` for Linux, `macos-universal.dmg` for macOS (Apple silicon and Intel). Checksums are in `SHA256SUMS`.
- macOS: the apps are not notarized by Apple. After the first start, open *System Settings → Privacy & Security* and click *Open Anyway* (or run `xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/<App>.app`).

---
